en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a street scene in an older European town with a group of people, possibly soldiers, walking down the street. The buildings are ornate, with one on the right displaying a German Empire-era flag. The location is labeled as 'Kamenz i. Sa.', and the view is noted as looking from the barracks ('Kaserne') towards the city. In the background, one can see the silhouette of a church or civic tower and a charming urban landscape.
